description: This file defines classes and functions for interfacing with Amazon Bedrock's Anthroplic Claude model family. It includes configuration classes, request transformation methods, and streaming response handling for invoking the Claude models via Bedrock's /v1/messages API. The code manages request signings, URL construction, request modifications (like removing unsupported fields), beta feature injections, and streaming decoder logic to parse Bedrock's response format into anthropic /messages style.

classes.name: AmazonAnthropicClaudeMessagesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for calling Amazon Bedrock's Anthropic Claude models through the /v1/messages API, including request validation, signing, URL generation, and request transformation with support for beta features.

classes.name: AmazonAnthropicClaudeMessagesStreamDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for parsing Bedrock streaming responses into anthropic /messages format, including handling of usage metrics and chunk parsing.
